sources.snippet: The model is evaluated across various benchmarks, including comprehensive reasoning, knowledge, commonsense, factuality, coding, math, chatting, instruction-following, and harmlessness, in both Korean and English. sources.title: HyperCLOVA X | CLOVA
sources.snippet: HyperCLOVA X SEED 8B Omni is a Korean-centered any-to-any model that processes and generates text, images, and audio through a unified architecture. Built on deep Korean-language understanding, it seamlessly handles explanations, conversations, visual analysis, and voice interactions within integrated reasoning workflows.
